image_description: A close-up shot of a white toilet paper roll mounted on a metallic, curved holder against a beige wall. The surface of the toilet paper features embossed text in a stylized, pseudo-Cyrillic or fantasy font, which appears to be an AI-generated artifact rather than standard branding. The roll has a visible quilted texture.

artifact_observations.location: Surface of the toilet paper roll
artifact_observations.reasoning: The roll features prominent, nonsensical text that mimics Cyrillic or fantasy script. This is a classic AI generation artifact where the model attempts to render text but fails to produce legible characters, resulting in 'glyph salad'.
The embossed letters blend slightly into the quilted texture without clear physical displacement shadows, suggesting a texture-painting artifact rather than true geometric embossing.
